guide: Open Start and type your studio name and your own limits in the yellow cells: target scores, wanted trade discount, on-time target, the largest share for one vendor, the days that count as on time and the score weights.
Check Team and Vendors. They hold the people and the vendors on trade accounts that every other sheet looks up.
Fill Trade Accounts with the credit limit, discount tier, rep and any annual rebate agreement of each vendor. Used credit and headroom fill in from Vendor Payments.
Log each purchase order on Purchase Orders and each delivery on Delivery Performance. Delay days, the on-time flag and the days late fill in for you.
Record each deposit, balance or credit on Vendor Payments. The open balance, days late and the overdue state fill in for each vendor.
Keep Vendor Price Lists up to date with the list price, trade price and valid-until date. The discount share and the expiry check show what to renew.
Write each damaged, wrong or short delivery on Quality Issues. The damage rate on the Vendor Scorecard comes from this log.
Mark price and communication on Vendor Scorecard each quarter. Overall score and rank fill in, and Vendor Comparison shows the best value vendor in each category.
Record every trade job on Trade Jobs with its quote, actual cost and rework days. Contractors and Contractor Scorecard show the true cost and the score.
Use Contractor Availability, Contractor Quotes and Contractor Payments to plan the next job, compare quotes and pay on the due date.
Check Document Checks every month: insurance, licence and certificate dates with the days to expiry. Do not start a job on an expired document.
Log vendor visits on Vendor Visits, keep Preferred Vendors by room type and review Vendor Risks on their review dates.
Use the 14 calculators for scores, best value, discount needed, rebate tiers, quote comparison, true cost, payment priority, credit, lead time, concentration and booking.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the dashboard and charts every week: order value, scores, on-time rate, balances, trade spend, overruns, booked days and expiring documents.

listing.title: Interior Designer Vendors, Trades and Contractors Excel Template: Vendor Scorecard, Trade Accounts, Quotes, True Cost, Document Checks
listing.headline: Know which vendors and contractors deserve your next order
listing.description:
Manage the vendors and contractors of an interior design studio in one Excel workbook. Vendors shows every trade account with its category, trade discount, deposit, lead time, orders, order value, share of spend, open balance and on-time share. Vendor Scorecard turns on-time share, damage rate and your price and communication marks into one weighted score and a rank, and Vendor Comparison names the best value vendor in each category.

Purchase Orders, Vendor Payments and Delivery Performance show delays, days late and overdue balances. Trade Accounts keeps the credit limit, headroom and annual rebate of each vendor, Vendor Price Lists warns before a trade price list expires, Quality Issues records damaged or wrong items with the credit agreed, and Vendor Risks and Preferred Vendors by room type keep the next order safe.

On the contractor side, Contractors, Trade Jobs and Contractor Scorecard compare quote with actual cost, add the cost of rework to give the true cost, and rank every trade. Contractor Availability, Contractor Quotes, Contractor Payments and Document Checks show who is free, which quote won, what is held as retention and which insurance or licence expires.

14 calculators cover a vendor score, best value, the discount needed for a target margin, volume rebate tiers, quote comparison, true cost of a job, day rate to fixed price, payment priority, early payment discount, credit headroom, lead time reliability, concentration, booking and a margin what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part seven of the Interior Designer suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small design studio to explore first. It helps you plan your purchasing and does not promise results.

documents.title: Vendor scorecard report
paragraphs: Vendor scorecard report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Vendor: {col:scorecard.vendor}. Last review: {col:scorecard.review_on}.
Orders: {col:scorecard.orders}, order value {col:scorecard.order_value}, which is {col:scorecard.share} of all orders.
On-time share: {col:scorecard.ontime_share}. Damage and quality rate: {col:scorecard.damage_rate}. Price mark: {col:scorecard.price_score} of 5. Communication mark: {col:scorecard.comm_score} of 5.
Overall score: {col:scorecard.overall}, target {col:scorecard.target_score}, rank {col:scorecard.rank}. Result: {col:scorecard.verdict}.
Actions for the next quarter and the person who owns each one are written below.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Trade account application letter
paragraphs: Letter of {set:company}, dated {today}.
Dear {col:accounts.rep}, we would like to open or update a trade account with {col:accounts.vendor}. We are an interior design studio that buys furniture, fittings and equipment for our clients.

We ask for the trade price, a discount tier of {col:accounts.discount_tier} ({col:accounts.trade_discount}), payment terms of {col:accounts.terms_days} days and a credit limit of {col:accounts.credit_limit}.
We expect orders of about {col:accounts.year_value} this year and would value a volume rebate of {col:accounts.rebate_pct} above {col:accounts.rebate_from}. Prices are before any tax.
Please send your account form, your trade terms and your current price list.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Vendor performance review letter
paragraphs: Performance review of {set:company}, dated {today}, for {col:scorecard.vendor}.
Dear partner, we review every vendor each year. Your on-time share was {col:scorecard.ontime_share} and your damage and quality rate was {col:scorecard.damage_rate}.
Your overall score is {col:scorecard.overall} against our target of {col:scorecard.target_score}, rank {col:scorecard.rank}. Result: {col:scorecard.verdict}.
We would like to agree how to keep late deliveries and damaged items low, and to confirm your trade discount and lead times for the next year.
Please reply with your plan and a date for a call.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Quality issue notice to a vendor
paragraphs: Quality issue notice of {set:company}, dated {today}. Vendor: {col:issues.vendor}. Issue {col:issues.issue_id}.
Purchase order {col:issues.po_id}, delivery {col:issues.delivery_id}. Problem found on {col:issues.date}: {col:issues.kind}.
Resolution so far: {col:issues.resolution}. Credit agreed: {col:issues.credit}. Resolved on: {col:issues.resolved_on}. State: {col:issues.state}.
Please confirm the replacement or the credit in writing and tell us the date. The item stays with the client or at the receiving warehouse until you reply.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Contractor scope and quote request
paragraphs: Quote request of {set:company}, dated {today}, to {col:cquotes.contractor}.
Project {col:cquotes.project_id}, {col:cquotes.project}. Scope: {col:cquotes.scope}.
Please send a fixed quote, the number of days and the start date you can offer. Our last figure for this scope was {col:cquotes.quote}, about {col:cquotes.implied_days} days at your day rate.
Please state what is included, what is not included, the materials you supply and the retention you expect. Prices are before any tax.
We would like your reply within one week.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Contractor agreement summary for a job
paragraphs: Agreement summary of {set:company}, dated {today}. Job {col:jobs.job_id} for project {col:jobs.project_id}, {col:jobs.project}.
Contractor: {col:jobs.contractor}, trade {col:jobs.trade}. Scope: {col:jobs.scope}.
Start {col:jobs.start_date}, end {col:jobs.end_date}, {col:jobs.days} days. Agreed price: {col:jobs.quoted}. Status: {col:jobs.status}.
Changes to the scope are priced in writing before the work starts. A part of each payment is held as retention until the finishing fixes are done. Payment follows the dates in the payment schedule.
Both parties sign below to confirm this summary.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Contractor performance review
paragraphs: Contractor review of {set:company}, dated {today}. Contractor: {col:cscore.contractor}. Last review: {col:cscore.review_on}.
Jobs: {col:cscore.jobs}. Quality mark {col:cscore.quality}, punctuality mark {col:cscore.punctuality}, communication mark {col:cscore.comm_score}, all out of 5.
Average overrun on the quote: {col:cscore.avg_overrun}. Rework days per job: {col:cscore.rework_job}. True cost with rework: {col:cscore.true_cost}, a true overrun of {col:cscore.true_overrun}.
Overall score {col:cscore.overall}, rank {col:cscore.rank}. Result: {col:cscore.verdict}.
Agreed actions for the next year are written below.

Discount check: {col:vendors.disc_ok}. Concentration check: {col:vendors.conc_flag}.

fr.Record each deposit, balance or credit o: Enregistrez chaque dépôt, solde ou crédit sur Paiements des fournisseurs. Le solde ouvert, les jours de retard et l'état de retard sont renseignés pour chaque fournisseur.
fr.Keep Vendor Price Lists up to date with: Tenez Listes de prix des fournisseurs au courant du prix catalogue, du prix commercial et de la date de validité. La part de réduction et le chèque d'expiration indiquent ce qu'il faut renouveler.
fr.Write each damaged, wrong or short deliv: Écrivez chaque livraison endommagée, erronée ou incomplète sur Problèmes de qualité. Le taux de dégâts sur le Carte de pointage du fournisseur provient de ce journal.

fr.Use the 14 calculators for scores, best: Utilisez les 14 calculateurs pour les scores, le meilleur rapport qualité-prix, la remise nécessaire, les niveaux de remise, la comparaison des devis, le coût réel, la priorité de paiement, le crédit, le délai de livraison, la concentration et la réservation.
fr.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprimez 10 feuilles et 10 documents, suivez 10 listes de contrôle et appuyez sur un lien de message pour envoyer un texte avec les détails déjà écrits.
fr.Read the dashboard and charts every week: Lisez le tableau de bord et les graphiques chaque semaine : valeur des commandes, scores, taux de ponctualité, soldes, dépenses commerciales, dépassements, jours réservés et documents expirant.

fr.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Modifiez le texte ici ; les mots entre {accolades} sont remplis à partir de chaque ligne. Les liens se trouvent dans les tableaux.
fr.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Choisissez un dossier : chaque étape reçoit sa date d’échéance. Copiez cette feuille pour chaque nouveau dossier.
fr.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Graphiques actualisés à partir de vos feuilles. Choisissez dans les cellules jaunes pour actualiser les graphiques et les jauges.

de.Check Team and Vendors. They hold the pe: Überprüfen Sie Team und Anbieter. Sie führen die Personen und Lieferanten auf Handelskonten, die auf jeder anderen Seite nachgeschlagen werden.
de.Fill Trade Accounts with the credit limi: Füllen Sie Handelskonten mit dem Kreditlimit, der Rabattstufe, dem Vertreter und einer etwaigen jährlichen Rabattvereinbarung jedes Lieferanten aus. Verwendetes Guthaben und Headroom-Ausfüllung von Lieferantenzahlungen.
de.Log each purchase order on Purchase Orde: Protokollieren Sie jede Bestellung am Bestellungen und jede Lieferung am Lieferleistung. Verspätungstage, die Pünktlichkeitsflagge und die Verspätungstage werden für Sie eingetragen.
de.Record each deposit, balance or credit o: Erfassen Sie jede Einzahlung, jeden Saldo oder jedes Guthaben auf Lieferantenzahlungen. Für jeden Lieferanten werden der offene Saldo, die Verspätungstage und der Überfälligkeitsstatus eingetragen.
de.Keep Vendor Price Lists up to date with: Halten Sie Preislisten der Anbieter mit dem Listenpreis, dem Handelspreis und dem Gültig-bis-Datum auf dem Laufenden. Der Rabattanteil und der Ablaufcheck zeigen, was verlängert werden muss.
de.Write each damaged, wrong or short deliv: Schreiben Sie jede beschädigte, falsche oder zu geringe Lieferung auf Qualitätsprobleme. Die Schadensrate auf der Lieferanten-Scorecard stammt aus diesem Protokoll.
de.Mark price and communication on Vendor S: Markieren Sie Preis und Kommunikation jedes Quartal auf Lieferanten-Scorecard. Geben Sie die Gesamtpunktzahl und den Rang ein, und Anbietervergleich zeigt den Anbieter mit dem besten Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis in jeder Kategorie an.
de.Record every trade job on Trade Jobs wit: Erfassen Sie jeden Handelsauftrag am Handelsjobs mit Angebot, tatsächlichen Kosten und Nacharbeitstagen. Auftragnehmer und Scorecard für Auftragnehmer zeigen die tatsächlichen Kosten und die Punktzahl.
de.Use Contractor Availability, Contractor: Verwenden Sie Verfügbarkeit von Auftragnehmern, Angebote von Auftragnehmern und Zahlungen des Auftragnehmers, um den nächsten Auftrag zu planen, Angebote zu vergleichen und am Fälligkeitsdatum zu zahlen.
de.Check Document Checks every month: insur: Überprüfen Sie jeden Monat Dokumentenprüfungen: Versicherungs-, Lizenz- und Zertifikatsdaten mit den Ablauftagen. Starten Sie keinen Job mit einem abgelaufenen Dokument.
de.Log vendor visits on Vendor Visits, keep: Protokollieren Sie Lieferantenbesuche bei Lieferantenbesuche, behalten Sie Bevorzugte Anbieter nach Zimmertyp bei und bewerten Sie Anbieterrisiken zu den jeweiligen Bewertungsdaten.
de.Use the 14 calculators for scores, best: Nutzen Sie die 14 Rechner für Punkte, besten Wert, benötigten Rabatt, Rabattstufen, Angebotsvergleich, tatsächliche Kosten, Zahlungspriorität, Kredit, Vorlaufzeit, Konzentration und Buchung.
de.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Drucken Sie 10 Blätter und 10 Dokumente aus, folgen Sie 10 Checklisten und tippen Sie auf einen Nachrichtenlink, um einen Text mit den bereits eingetragenen Details zu senden.
de.Read the dashboard and charts every week: Lesen Sie jede Woche das Dashboard und die Diagramme: Bestellwert, Ergebnisse, Pünktlichkeitsrate, Salden, Handelsausgaben, Überschreitungen, gebuchte Tage und ablaufende Dokumente.

de.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Aktuelle Diagramme deiner Tabellen. Wähle die gelben Zellen aus, und alle Diagramme und Messanzeigen werden automatisch aktualisiert.

nl.Open Start and type your studio name and: Open Start en typ uw studionaam en uw eigen limieten in de gele cellen: doelscores, gewenste handelskorting, doel op tijd, het grootste aandeel voor één leverancier, de dagen die tellen als op tijd en de scoregewichten.
nl.Check Team and Vendors. They hold the pe: Controleer team en leveranciers. Ze houden de mensen en de verkopers op handelsrekeningen die elk ander blad opzoekt.
nl.Fill Trade Accounts with the credit limi: Vul Handelsrekeningen in met de kredietlimiet, het kortingsniveau, de vertegenwoordiger en eventuele jaarlijkse kortingsovereenkomsten van elke leverancier. Gebruikte credit- en vrije ruimte invullen vanaf Betalingen van leveranciers.
nl.Log each purchase order on Purchase Orde: Registreer elke inkooporder op Inkooporders en elke levering op Leveringsprestaties. Vertragingsdagen, de op tijd-vlag en de dagen te laat worden voor u ingevuld.
nl.Record each deposit, balance or credit o: Registreer elke storting, saldo of tegoed op Betalingen van leveranciers. Voor elke leverancier worden het openstaande saldo, het aantal dagen te laat en de status van achterstalligheid ingevuld.
nl.Keep Vendor Price Lists up to date with: Houd Prijslijsten van leveranciers op de hoogte van de catalogusprijs, handelsprijs en geldigheidsdatum. Het kortingsaandeel en de vervalcontrole laten zien wat u moet verlengen.
nl.Write each damaged, wrong or short deliv: Schrijf elke beschadigde, verkeerde of korte levering op Kwaliteitsproblemen. Het schadepercentage op de Scorekaart van leverancier komt uit dit logboek.
nl.Mark price and communication on Vendor S: Markeer de prijs en communicatie elk kwartaal op Scorekaart van leverancier. De algemene score en rang worden ingevuld en Vergelijking van leveranciers toont de leverancier met de beste waarde in elke categorie.
nl.Record every trade job on Trade Jobs wit: Leg elke handelsopdracht op Handel banen vast met de bijbehorende offerte, werkelijke kosten en herbewerkingsdagen. Aannemers en Scorekaart voor aannemers tonen de werkelijke kosten en de score.
nl.Use Contractor Availability, Contractor: Gebruik Beschikbaarheid van aannemers, Offertes van aannemers en Betalingen aan de aannemer om de volgende klus te plannen, offertes te vergelijken en op de vervaldatum te betalen.
nl.Check Document Checks every month: insur: Controleer elke maand Documentcontroles: verzekerings-, licentie- en certificaatdatums met de vervaldagen. Start geen taak op een verlopen document.
nl.Log vendor visits on Vendor Visits, keep: Registreer leveranciersbezoeken op Bezoeken van leveranciers, bewaar Voorkeursleveranciers op kamertype en beoordeel Risico's van leveranciers op hun beoordelingsdatums.
nl.Use the 14 calculators for scores, best: Gebruik de 14 rekenmachines voor scores, beste waarde, benodigde korting, kortingsniveaus, offertevergelijking, werkelijke kosten, betalingsprioriteit, krediet, doorlooptijd, concentratie en boeking.
nl.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Druk 10 vellen en 10 documenten af, volg 10 checklists en tik op een berichtlink om een sms te sturen met de details al geschreven.
nl.Read the dashboard and charts every week: Lees elke week het dashboard en de grafieken: orderwaarde, scores, tijdspercentage, saldi, handelsuitgaven, overschrijdingen, geboekte dagen en verlopende documenten.
nl.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Alle keuzelijsten in dit bestand. Wijzig hier een item en de wijziging wordt op elk werkblad doorgevoerd.
nl.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Wordt bijgewerkt vanuit je werkbladen. Wijzig het jaar om terug te kijken.
nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
